newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials cut their losses, push off lows.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials cut their losses, push off lows.

text.p: U.S. blue chips recouped some ground by midafternoon Friday after steep losses pushed the Dow below 8,000 points amid concerns about a higher interest rate outlook.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 123 points, or 1.5 percent, at 8065, after sliding more than 200 points to a session low of 7976.

The bond market was mired near its session lows, with investors concerned about inflation and the direction of interest rates ahead of economic data due next week. The long bond was down 1-17/32 to yield 6.64 percent.
The Nasdaq composite was off 26 points to 1598.
